checks.name: Cancelled preview and cancelled element edit leave history and page state exact

Whole value editor retains semicolons as one audited replacement

Batch confirmation records each target with its own exact before and after
Sequential batch changes to one target retain each intermediate raw value without invented element diffs
All-unchanged batch confirmation adds no history entry
Missing original and present empty original remain distinct in stored history
Element editor apply records exact raw strings after duplicate, empty and markup edits
History disclosure shows escaped raw strings and cannot change operational state
Editor sidebar has separate app and profile groups with independent list containers
Sidebar CSS assigns two constrained groups and overflow to each list
Sidebar app and profile buttons select correctly while table rows select variables by mouse and keyboard
History and sidebar workflows produce no JSDOM runtime errors
